name: Signalman
feature_notes: An owner can report a problem to their vessel’s appointed Captain. The Admiral can read the status and verification note. Test Center controls have their own space in the Legacy Plumbing and Signal Restoration previews.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.

install_step: Apply SIGNALMAN_FLEET_HELP.sql once in Fleet Core to enable shared reports.
